definitions.explanation: A completely white color with no other tints mixed in. Often carries connotations of purity, innocence, or elegance.

examples.japanese: {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ウェディングドレス→ウェディングドレス：27343_wedingudoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She wore a pure white wedding dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}もって→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{純白|じゅんぱく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: Snow piled up, and the garden was covered in pure white.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ステンド⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The bride's pure white gown shone beautifully, illuminated by the light through the church's stained glass.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a no-adjective: {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Carries poetic or elevated nuance compared to simply saying ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧. Frequently associated with weddings, snow scenes, and things that symbolize purity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧ (pure white dress)
- {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (pure white snow)
- {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (pure white flowers)
- {純白|じゅんぱく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧ (shine in pure white)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧: pure white — more colloquial; can also mean 'blank' (as in a blank page or mind)
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧: white — the basic color word
